author: ojiudezue
title: v5.92.0 shipped: EVSE/L1 charge-onset gate (ships dormant, enable OFF)
summary: EVSE/L1 charge-onset gate (ships dormant, enable OFF)
why: Operator wants EV/L1 charging held until a cheap overnight onset time. Two prior attempts failed by gating a single wrong/incomplete site (drain-release, then ensure-on) — there is no single turn-on site; a charger is started by ~15 paths. v3 wraps the turn-on emission in a shared funnel and gates every real start path, with must-start-by/solar/force-charge as bypass. Ships DORMANT (enable OFF) so the operator can enable-and-test deliberately with zero deploy-time behavior change. Delicate energy code: built and verified to leave DP/drain/arbitrage/solar decision logic byte-identical.
implications: Shipped EVSE-CHARGE-ONSET-TIME-1 at v5.92.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.92.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: With switch.ura_ev_charge_onset_enabled ON before 01:00 on an off-peak night: binary_sensor.ura_ev_charge_onset_active==on AND garage_a/garage_b + smartplug_moes_wifi_garagealeftfront sockets all off, then all switch to on at ~01:00 (query ev_charging_status + switch history).

refs.release_notes: Gated turn-on funnel holds EV/L1 charging until a configurable onset time (default 01:00, 8h bounded window) across all real start paths (ensure-on, DP reversion, arbitrage release, fill-priority dusk, drain-release); must-start-by 03:00 + excess-solar + force-charge bypass; enable switch defaults OFF so deploy is byte-identical to v5.91.4 until the operator turns it on. Tier-3: 4 framing-disjoint reviews + orchestrator neuter re-verify.
